params.name: searchText
params.description: The text to search for. Mandatory, and must always be supplied on the query string (documented exception in the ACMA guide: it is passed as a query parameter rather than a path segment so it may itself contain '/', which appears in many licence numbers).

params.name: searchField
params.description: The field to search; any detail can be used to search all fields.

params.name: searchOption
params.description: How searchText is matched: matches, begins with, or sounds like.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the results by.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of records to skip over. Used with resultsLimit to page beyond the 2,000-record cap (0, 2000, 4000, ...).

params.name: resultsLimit
params.description: The number of records to return after the offset. The service caps any single query at 2,000 records.

items.docs:
Returns an XElement containing all licences for the specified search terms.

A single query returns at most 2,000 records; page with the offset parameter to retrieve more. For the whole dataset, ACMA publishes a same-day full RRL extract as a zip download rather than serving it through this API.
